products.title: Night Garden First Stitch Mini
products.one_line: A calm botanical mini designed to turn your first stitch into a finished piece.
products.description_html:
Start needlepoint without starting a supply collection. Night Garden is a compact, original mini project built around one beginner stitch and a clear color path.

The planned complete kit includes a printed 10–13 mesh canvas, pre-sorted thread with learning-room overage, a blunt tapestry needle, a threader, a quick-start card, and original video help. The small format is designed to become a self-finished ornament, patch, tag, or mini display—without sending it to a professional finisher.

  • Skill level: true beginner
  • Prior experience: none planned
  • Finished design: approximately 3.5–4 in
  • Colors: 6
  • Core technique: one diagonal tent stitch
  • Age positioning: adult craft kit; contains a needle

Pre-launch note: this listing is in draft until physical sample, thread quantity, print alignment, completion time, and ship date are verified.

products.title: Pick Any Two First Stitch Minis
products.one_line: Two complete mini projects: keep both or make one alongside someone you like.
products.description_html:
Two small projects make a better first craft night. Choose two original First Stitch Mini designs and receive two complete planned kits—each with its own canvas, color set, beginner tools, quick-start card, and video help.

The duo is designed for a friend night, a low-pressure date, or one project now and one next. Each kit remains individually usable; no materials need to be shared.

  • Two complete mini kits
  • Planned U.S. shipping included
  • True-beginner format
  • Choose any two founding designs
  • Adult use; each kit contains a needle

Pre-launch note: the bundle will open only after each included design passes sample and novice testing.

products.title: Stitch Rescue Pack
products.one_line: Backup threader, blunt needle, and matching repair thread for a calmer finish.
products.description_html:
A compact backup pack for the two tiny things most likely to disappear mid-project. The planned Stitch Rescue Pack includes one blunt tapestry needle, one needle threader, and a small matching thread reserve selected for the kit in your order.

This is a service add-on, not a substitute for a full kit. It is intended for active First Thread Studio projects and will be offered only with a compatible kit.

  • 1 blunt tapestry needle
  • 1 needle threader
  • Matching thread reserve
  • Adult use; contains a needle

Pre-launch note: component specifications are pending supplier and safety review.
